title: 🧠 Amazing news from the world of wearables!
body: 🧠 Amazing news from the world of wearables!
Apple has acquired Sonera, a company specialising in brain-sensing technology that reads nerve signals from the body without surgery.

Simply put: a smartwatch or smart band that understands the signals from your muscles and nerves, helping athletes improve their performance and helping people who have lost limbs control prosthetics with natural movement.
The deal surfaced in an official filing with the European Union, and Apple has not announced the details yet.
Would you trust a device that reads signals from your body? And what use would you most like to see?
